evidence_class: native_proven for this one WSL2 host's live service configuration; not a release or pin change
change: The host's live ai-memory now embeds with nvidia/Nemotron-3-Embed-1B-BF16 (2048 dimensions) through the resident local vLLM embedding service that also serves SocratiCode, with the publisher's query:/passage: prefixes, instead of the built-in all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384 dimensions).

pin_deviation.running: ai-memory 2.3.2 plus the query/document prefix patch proposed upstream
pin_deviation.why_2_3_2_based: stock 2.3.2 binaries invoked by the Claude and Codex hooks abort on a store migrated to the 2.4.0 schema (refinery abort_missing), so the patch was applied to 2.3.2 to keep the schema unchanged
review: three review rounds of the upstream patch by an independent Claude reviewer and a Codex cross-family reviewer, all findings fixed
an independent deploy-safety review of the 2.3.2 cherry-pick (three hunks dropped because they touch 2.4.0-only features)
tests on the 2.3.2 base: llm 270/0, mcp 444/0, consolidate+wiki 409/0, cli-lib and cli suite with the same pre-existing failures as stock

configuration.embedding_service: vLLM 0.25.0 with --max-model-len raised from 4096 to 8192 through a systemd drop-in

observed_after.hook_capture: observations continued to increase after the restart
observed_after.live_query: memory_query returned hits with all four retrieval streams active
observed_after.code_search: SocratiCode search returned results after the embedding service restart

rollback: a backup and the previous configuration were saved before the change; rollback removes the two systemd drop-ins, restores the configuration, restarts both services and re-embeds with the built-in model. A stock ai-memory serve must not be started against the store without that re-embed: it ignores the prefixed identity for vector search and its re-embed would overwrite the prefixed vectors.
follow_up: When upstream releases the prefix support, move the service and hook binaries to that release together and return to a stock pin.
